title: REASONING BOOSTS OPINION ALIGNMENT IN LLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of LLM agents in simulating individual political preferences across different ideological groups (Left, Center, Right) using survey data (ANES, Wahl-O-Mat, smartvote) to identify systematic disparities in accuracy and learnability.

Projecting agent responses into a Principal Component Analysis (PCA) space to analyze shifts in political positioning relative to human ground truth (e.g., detecting left-libertarian shifts) and measuring the impact of using progressively or conservatively biased synthetic data for fine-tuning.

Analyzing the model's ability to predict 'Neutral' survey responses compared to 'Yes'/'No' answers and determining the correlation between the frequency of neutral responses and overall predictive performance.
